items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Barney told me to call him, because I asked Barney about what's the place of the street

ctx.x: Barney told me to call him, because I asked Barney about what's the place of the street where "Some kind of street called the sporting class live, and he said, 'Perdito', 'some kind of street named that."
I said, but that sounds like a Spanish word called 'perdito', which means lost. You know? So I said I'm going to call it 'lost' -- Perdito.

items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Tizol, I think, came in after me, not long.

ctx.x: Hodges was with Chick Webb. Cootie was with Chick Webb. Cootie came after me. Hodges came after me. That's about all. But it wasn't long after. Tizol, I think, came in after me, not long. They sent for him from Washington. And Whetsql, Art Whetsql.
